body:
[A10] Documentation observation X2 from [R223 review](https://github.com/Mister-M-alt/protocol-processor-control-plane-avb-milan/pull/96#issuecomment-5772081981), pre-existing and outside PR96 scope.

Evidence at ea93023: docs/guides/integrator.md section 2 omits N_AUDIO_UNIT_P, N_CLK_DOMAIN_P, N_CONTROL_P, REG_TL_TIMEOUT_MS_P and LOCK_TIMEOUT_MS_P from protocol_processor_top. Diagram 21 also has a partial parameter list, used as a summary. PR96 documents its new parameter and does not claim to repair this inventory.

Objective: decide and publish whether section 2 is the complete integration parameter contract or an explicitly scoped summary, then reconcile it with the actual top interface. Authority/context: docs/README.md single-source and normative-document rules, architecture F01.5, hdl/top/protocol_processor_top.sv, integrator guide section 2 and diagram 21 master. Do not duplicate authoritative parameter values outside their allowed home.

Backlog: the desired inventory scope and diagram-summary contract need a public decision before implementation. Proposed acceptance: enumerate actual parameters, identify each documented owner, update missing interface descriptions or explicitly define a bounded summary, preserve diagram/source consistency, and pass donor documentation gates. No RTL/default change. Exact validation and executor/reviewers are assigned after readiness review. Related #70 covers authoritative value single-sourcing, which this task must preserve.
title: Audit the integrator top-parameter inventory against the public RTL interface
